notUsed.name: Conditor 0.10.18
notUsed.reason: Its fsharp-limen-web scaffold installs the full governed environment (Praxis, Ordo, Aegis, branch protection, inert Pages workflow) for a new empty repository. Specula already had requirements and a Pages configuration; the app follows the scaffold's layout conventions (F# engine, C# JSExport shim, npm root, Playwright, Pages workflow) without running it. Recorded as a deliberate exception.

notUsed.reason: Not runtime dependencies. Their released evidence formats were inspected; the observed rehearsal repository publishes causa.* / indy-init.* evidence, which the adapter registry supports exactly.
